topic: Besi hybrid-bonding customer count at end-2025
disagreement: Besi's FY2025 release (Feb 2026) says hybrid-bonding adoption expanded to 18 customers in 2025; its Q2-26 release (Jul 2026) says adoption increased 'from 15 at year end 2025' to 21.
possible_reasons: definition: the later count may exclude customers with only evaluation/R&D tools or merge related entities
restatement or correction by Besi without explanation
rationale: Both are Besi's own counts for the same date, with near-identical wording. Neither release explains the change, so neither can be preferred on evidence.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether Besi had 15 or 18 hybrid-bonding customers at end-2025 and how it defines 'customer adoption'. The Q2-26 count of 21 uses the later basis.
